User message with mixed text and image_url content parts to verify multimodal serialization

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 100, messages: [{ 'content' => [{ 'text' => 'What is in this image?', 'type' => 'text' }, { 'image_url' => { 'detail' => 'low', 'url' => 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/47/PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png/280px-PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png' }, 'type' => 'image_url' }], 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4o'))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
```
